reserveReview.rationale: wM wraps M 1:1, so its reserve relationship is the reviewed M0 collateral system rather than a separate reserve pool. M0 documents eligible off-chain collateral in SPVs, validator signatures on collateral updates, and the tracked M metadata identifies short-term U.S. Treasury bills as the collateral envelope.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact live Wrapped M single-asset row, wrapped-M implementation, and inherited M dependency
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: M0 does not publish current minter-level balances, Treasury holdings, or a dated report scoped specifically to the wM wrapper.
